title: Track LLM API Token Usage per Request with One jq Filter
description:
Know what every AI request costs with one jq filter. 🪙

✅ Every API response has a usage field
✅ Pipe it through jq
✅ See input and output tokens per request

Day 6 of Build AI Apps. Next up: Day 7, Cache a Long Prompt to Cut Cost.

comment: Input or output: which costs you more? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: add up these two numbers across requests to see your total spend.
